author: Cinna Davis with OpenAI Codex assistance
statement: An exact ordered frontier network computes binary-matroid independence using at most 2^(floor(b^2/4)+b) subspaces per layer and O(m b^2) state-bit incidences; a sparse paired-column family has cut rank 2^b in a specified order. No SAT bound improvement is claimed.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the all-size construction and cut-rank argument
Prove efficiently constructible low-width orderings for the actual sparse hash matrices
Integrate clause-violation tensors and characteristic-two semantics with a full contraction and complete costs
No improved 3-SAT bound or alpha is claimed
